application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a part two, part single storey rear extension, single storey side infill extension and side and rear roof dormer extensions, removal of a ground floor side window, installation of one front roof light and one first floor side window and conversion of the existing single storey side garage to a habitable space.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  Unreferenced Block Plan  Received:  04 April 2024;  24005/03 (Rev A); 24005/04 (Rev A)  Received:  26 March 2024;  24005/01; 24005/02; Unreferenced Site Location Plan  Received:  02 February 2024.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the part two, part single storey rear extension, single storey side infill extension, rear roof dormer extension and side roof dormer extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding Proposed Elevation 24005/04 (Rev A), the double side window of the proposed side roof dormer extension and additional high level first floor side window hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, non-openable below 1.75 metres above finished floor level and be permanently retained as such.
